meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把一段技术内容翻成大白话,讲清它「是谁、是什么、为什么」等几个角度。产出是一段不带术语的解释。
howto.when: 当你想让某个技术内容用大白话讲清楚,或提出「who、what、why」式的拆解需求时,由它接手。

say.text: 用大白话讲讲这个:是谁、做什么、为什么
say.note: Claude 给出非技术版解释

say.text: 把这段 API 文档拆成 who、what、why
这个报错到底是什么意思?说人话

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns technical material into a plain-English rundown — who it's for, what it is, where, why and when. The output is a non-technical explanation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a plain-English explanation of something technical, or ask for the who, what and why of it.

say_en.text: Explain this in plain English: who, what and why
Break this API doc down into who, what and why
say_en.note: It splits it by who / what / why

say_en.text: What does this error actually mean? Plain English
